note: City of Akeley campground strung along the shore of Eleventh Crow Wing Lake, most RV sites backing onto the water with their own docks; on the Heartland State Trail, a short walk from downtown. Sand swimming beach, concrete boat ramp, fishing pier and fish-cleaning house. Monthly and season-long stays are also sold. --Claude
summary: Operator pages + rezStream read: 28 RV sites (30/50 A, water) + 14 tent, showers/flush/dump, May 1-Sep 30; $63/night (city-owned, so the private price gate doesn't apply). DROP CANDIDATE: rezStream requires a 7-night minimum on every RV site on every date tried. Lakefront confirmed by the operator's site photos (sites 17, 26, 28, 30, 32, 33 on open grass to the water with docks). Google 4.5/99.
flags: DROP CANDIDATE (standing 3+ night minimum): the campground's own booking engine shows 'A 7 night minimum is required.' and 'Must book at least a 7 night reservation' on all 17 RV sites it offers (16-21, 23-33), for one-night searches on 2026-11-20, 2027-05-18, 2027-06-15 and 2027-09-07 alike; only the tent sites book for one night. A 7-night search for June 12-19, 2027 found only Tent Site 43 open. RV sites 1-15 and 22 aren't offered online at all, and the rates page also sells monthly ($1,495) and seasonal ($3,450) stays, so a large share may be seasonal. A phone call might allow shorter stays; nothing on the site says so.
Price: $63 a night for an RV site (rezStream 2027; rates page 2026-10-15). Over US$50, but this is a City of Akeley campground and the price gate is for private parks only; noted for the reviewer.

WATERFRONT lakefront KEPT: the campground map puts sites 23-46 in a row between the road and Eleventh Crow Wing Lake and 1-13 along the shore at the west end. The operator's photos of sites 17, 26, 28, 30, 32 and 33 show open grass from the pad to the water, each with a dock, about 10-20 m. On imagery the row of rigs at about 47.0068,-94.7340 to 47.0080,-94.7322 sits 15-25 m from the shore behind a broken fringe of shoreline trees with an opening and a dock at each site; imagery alone would not settle it, the site photos do. Sites 26-33 are sold by the night online (subject to the 7-night minimum above).
Booking platform: stored 'phone' (derived) -> operator rezStream engine (https://guest.rezstream.com/search/akeleycitycampground).
Phone 218-252-4570 confirmed (operator site and Google Maps); City Hall is 218-652-2465. Website https://www.akeleycitycampground.com/ confirmed.

Pin 47.00560,-94.73480 sits in the trees beside the south-west part of the shoreline strip; the campground runs about 800 m from the office near 47.0045,-94.7358 north-east to the beach near 47.0100,-94.7305, so the pin is on the campground; no move proposed.
Note cleaned: dropped amps, dump, showers and 'Reservable by phone' (fields hold them or were wrong).
